item.title: Veterans Food Distribution event rescheduled due to bad weather
item.description: Raleigh County, WV (WOAY) – The veterans’ food distribution that was planned for Friday has been rescheduled due to inclement weather. The new date and time is for Friday, December 19 at 10 a.m. at the Linda K. Epling Stadium in Beckley. For more information, you can call Ron Hendrick at 304-228-6939.
